arabic text: ABBAS KYA SUNOGE MERE DARD KI KHABAR
english translation text: ABBAS AS WILL YOU BEAR TO LISTEN TO THE STATE OF MY GRIEF

arabic text: AAYA HUN MAI SAKINA KO BEHOSH CHHODKAR
english translation text: I HAVE COME LEAVING SAKINA SA BEHIND FAINTED

arabic text: ABBAS YAAD HOGA MADINE SE VOH SAFAR
english translation text: ABBAS AS YOU MAY REMEMBER WHEN WE COMMENCED OUR JOURNEY FROM MADINAH

arabic text: FEHRIST PADHKE ROYE THE TUM JISKE NAAM PAR
english translation text: WHOSE NAME YOU CRIED UPON AFTER READING THE LIST

arabic text: VOH HURMALA KE TEER SE BEJAAN HOGAYA
english translation text: HE IS NOW LIFELESS BY HURMALA'S ARROW

arabic text: JHOOLE SE AAKE DASHT MAI ASGHAR BHI SOGAYA
english translation text: ASGHER AS IS ALSO BENEATH DUST ASLEEP ON LAND FROM THE CRADLE,

arabic text: SHEH NE ALI ASGHAR KO JAB DAFN KIYA HOGA
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN AS MUST HAVE BURRIED HAZRAT ALI ASGHAR,

arabic text: ABBAS KA LASHA TO UTH UTHKE GIRA HOGA,
english translation text: ABBAS'S AS BODY MAY HAVE RISEN AND FALLEN SEVERAL TIMES.

arabic text: AISE HI TO SAR KAT KE NAIZE PE NAHI JAATA,
english translation text: THE HEAD DOESN'T JUST GET CUT ITSELF AND GO UPON THE SPEAR

arabic text: QAATIL NE ZIBHA BACHCHA PHIR ZIB-HA KIYA HOGA,
english translation text: THE KILLER MUST HAVE RE-SLAUGHTERED THE SLAUGHTERED INFANT.

arabic text: SAR KAAT KE ZAALIM NE JIS WAQT UCHHAALA THA
english translation text: WHEN THE OPRESSOR TOSSED THE HEAD AFTER BEHEADING

arabic text: ZAHRA KA KALEJA TO MITTI PE GIRA HOGA,
english translation text: ZAHRA'S SA LIVER MUST HAVE FALLEN UPON DUST,

arabic text: NAIZE PE JO BACHCHA THA OR OONT PE MAADAR THI
english translation text: THE CHILD THAT WAS UPON THE SPEAR AND MOTHER WAS ON THE CAMEL

arabic text: DIL GOD MAI LENE KO BECHAIN RAHA HOGA,
english translation text: HEART MUST BE FOND OF CARESSING AND CARRYING HIM.

arabic text: LO QATL KE BAAD ASGHAR AKBAR SE BADAA NIKLA
english translation text: SEE AFTER MARTYRDOM ASGHAR AS RESULTS GREATER THAN AKBAR AS

arabic text: CHHOTA SA KALEJA THA NAIZA TO BADAA HOGA
english translation text: LIVER WAS SMALL BUT THE SPEAR MUST HAVE BEEN BIG.

arabic text: JO JHOOLA JHULAATI THI MUN CHOOMTI JAATI THI
english translation text: WHO REPEATEDLY KISSED WHILE SWINGING THE CRADLE

arabic text: EK SAAL SAKINA NE BOSA NA DIYAA HOGA,
english translation text: MORE THAN A YEAR IT MUST BE FOR SAKINA SA TO HAVE KISSED ASGHAR AS,

arabic text: KYU QABR KI TAREEKI DHAMKAAYE MURAWWAT KO
english translation text: WHY WOULD THE DARKNESS OF THE GRAVE THREATEN MURAWWAT

arabic text: NOHA ALI ASGHAR KA MARQAD MAI PADHAA HOGA,\n(HE)
english translation text: MUST HAVE RECITED INSIDE THE GRAVE EULOGY OF ALI ASGHAR AS,
